text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We welcome the new year and the start of Manhattan Cafe's classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Normally, this would be a time to set ambitious resolutions, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: With this body… I'm in no position to be talking about wild ambitions yet…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This year, at the very least, I want to be able to touch the tips of her hair…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Manhattan Cafe struggling to toughen up her weak constitution, her goals remain out of reach. But, if nothing else, I can still lift her mood…
choice_data_list: How about we take a walk for a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That… might be nice. I shouldn't stay cooped up indoors…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Cafe and her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How was last year for you? With the few races I entered, I couldn't test a whole lot. Nothing impressive, overall.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You… don't seem in a rush to prove anything, though.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If things really weren't going well… you wouldn't be making that face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Very astute. After so many hours spent in the lab together, you've caught on to my thinking patterns.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're right, I'm in no rush. Everything is in line with my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This was always how Plan A was supposed to pan out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Agnes Tachyon sounds upbeat, I can't see any joy in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Realistically, however, if I keep running at this pace, I'm looking at another ten years before I reach the full potential of an Umamusume. As such…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I've decided to enter the Yayoi Sho, the trial race for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Yayoi Sho…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm sure you have your own path planned out. I just thought I'd let you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Who knows, maybe you'll want to enter now that you've heard I'll be running too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Quite… the opposite. I no longer wish to enter.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If we both entered, you'd be giving me all kinds of chores on the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, you're quite perceptive! It's only with your help that I can maintain my current lifestyle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Alone, I end up lying unconscious in the middle of the road. You really saved me that time, by the way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's… not normal…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Besides, you can't influence me. The only one who gets to decide my path… is my friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't let you sway— Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble… Rumble…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing. Just an illusion… right? It must have been…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble… Rumble…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, good day. Until we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Cheers to the year ahead. Whatever your path may be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon walks away, leaving Cafe disgruntled.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Could we… do something else? I think I'd like to… clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I want to forget about what Tachyon said, so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I collect myself and decide to go along with her request. But what should we do?
choice_data_list: Let's go see how the fish are doing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Go see the fish? I'm not sure what you mean, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If I can rinse all these thoughts away… I'd be happy to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take Manhattan Cafe to the aquarium, and we find ourselves utterly captivated by the tanks…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Fish swim on endlessly, quietly enduring the pressure from the water all around them…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I have to be as strong as they are…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After relating to the fish on an emotional level, Manhattan Cafe starts to understand what it means to be resilient.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Coffee… Yes, its rich aroma always helps me take my mind off things.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: All right… Why don't we go to that cafe? I usually go by myself, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you… know the "etiquette" here? This cafe has a certain… way of doing things…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: First, enjoy the scent drifting toward you… Then, savor a seasonal sip…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe enjoys her beverage, one careful sip at a time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm not very fond of crowded areas. I feel as if I'm going to get swallowed up and disappear.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But… if you're with me…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I might actually enjoy myself… browsing clothes and furniture I've never seen before…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, and the vintage siphons… I could find myself some antique cups, too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe isn't the type to go on strolls around town, but it looks like discovering some new items has lifted her spirits.
